낳다.e: to give birth; to give rise to
낳다.n: everyday; mother is subject; also eggs and causing results
cf: 출산하다
to give birth; to deliver
formal or medical; human childbirth only

건네받다.e: to be handed; to receive (something handed over)
건네받다.n: receive something someone hands you, the receiving side
cf: 건네다
to hand over; to address; to say to someone
gentle handing over, or offering words like greetings
넘기다
to hand over; to pass (a deadline); to turn (a page)
meaning shifts with the object, like deadline, page, task
양도하다
to hand over; to turn over; to transfer
formal; give property or rights to someone
인계하다
to hand over; to transfer
formal; hand work to a successor, workplace
인도하다
to hand over; to deliver; to lead or guide
formal; hand over goods or lead someone

애끓다.e: to be heartbroken; to be anguished
애끓다.n: intense emotional pain and grief, like the heart burning; literary
cf: 황폐하다
to be devastated; to be ruined; to be desolate
land, houses, or places left ruined; also hearts/minds worn out
